$source.note: After Dieter Rams: weniger, aber besser. The PDF is set in the rams layout (render/layouts/rams.ts): the cover as a Braun front panel — speaker grille, tuning wheel, one coloured switch, a tuning scale whose stations are the document's gates — and inside, one grid, a label column, hairlines, one quiet size and one accent. Arimo stands in for Akzidenz-Grotesk. Word gets the ordinary page in these colours and faces. Nothing of Braun's or Vitsœ's artwork is used.
